messages:
Anna (Partnerships): Heads up — we need an ISV onramp ops playbook for the LangChain / LlamaIndex + Gateway partners. Can we sync on required artifacts, preflight tests, and announcement gating? :wave:

Jordan (DevEx): +1. Thinking checklist: connector API contract, auth patterns, env var examples, demo app, smoke tests, packaging for marketplace.

Max (Eng Integrations): For runtime, we need: model variant compatibility matrix, latency SLOs, required hardware (GPU/CPU), quantization notes. I'll share a template.

Sara (Product): Also include rollout plan for Dedicated vs Hosted customers and fallback model policy.

Priya (Solutions Eng): We should add a support escalation path and SLOs for partner demos. Current partner onboarding doc is a bit ops-heavy — need a condensed "one-pager" for ISVs.

deploy-bot: Created checklist ticket #PART-4123 (assignee: Anna)

Anna (Partnerships): Good. Can someone draft the preflight smoke tests? Minimal set: auth handshake, simple generation call, embedding test, and fallback routing.

Max (Eng Integrations): I'll drop a test matrix. Example snippet for smoke test:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-2-small","input":"hello"}'
```

Jordan (DevEx): For packaging: marketplace listing meta (description, icons), terraform example, and a quickstart repo + badges. Who owns the repo today?

Priya (Solutions Eng): I can own the quickstart repo. ETA EOD Thu to get skeleton up.

Sara (Product): Timeline proposal: draft playbook by next Tue, internal review Wed, partner review Fri. Joint announcement target in 3 weeks if integration passes QA.

Anna (Partnerships): Assignments: Max = test matrix + infra reqs; Jordan = packaging + docs; Priya = quickstart repo + demo; Sara = rollout/announce; Anna = coordination & partner comms. Agree?

Jordan (DevEx): Agree. I'll stub the marketplace metadata schema and add a sample Terraform module and README.

Max (Eng Integrations): Also need to confirm gateway auth modes we support: API key, OIDC, and mTLS. Which do we require for marketplace vs Private? @Sara any product constraints?

Sara (Product): Marketplace = API key + optional OIDC; Private / VPC = OIDC/mTLS required. We'll document recommended flows.

Anna (Partnerships): Cool. @Max please open PR with template tests; @Jordan add marketplace checklist to docs repo. I'll ping LangChain contact to schedule a partner demo next Tue.

Ben (PartnerEng): +1 on demo slot. Can we add a "known limitations" section for large context windows, truncation guidance, and KV cache heuristics? Partners always ask about context behavior.

Max (Eng Integrations): Good call. Adding KV cache notes and recommended truncation strategy (explicit max_input_tokens + fallback to summary). Also will list perf numbers for 1k/4k/16k windows.

Anna (Partnerships): Thanks all. Quick ask — include contact points for escalation in the playbook (oncall, partner eng, devex). We'll iterate in PRs. :rocket:
